recent_changes.description: Created AINovelApplication and AppContainer for dependency injection of Room DB, RotationManager, and NovelGenerationEngine
Created AppViewModelProvider factory to inject real dependencies into Jetpack Compose ViewModels
Wired SettingsViewModel to hardware Android Keystore (SecureKeyStorage) and ApiKeyDao for live Gemini key management
Wired GeneratorViewModel to NovelGenerationEngine for real Gemini outline generation and token streaming, with fallback for tests
Removed hardcoded Chapter 4 active generation demo banner from DashboardViewModel; now cleanly reflects 0 active tasks on startup
Compiled debug APK and installed via ADB onto physical test device 3B658D010BU00000; verified with on-screen screenshot

decisions_made.decision: Use AppContainer + AppViewModelProvider over heavy Hilt framework
decisions_made.reason: Lightweight, zero annotation-processing overhead, fast build times, and maintains 100% test compatibility with Robolectric

decisions_made.decision: Support Dual-mode ViewModels (Production with injected engine vs Test with default values)
decisions_made.reason: Allows Robolectric Phase 5 tests to run independently without requiring a physical Android Keystore while production uses hardware encryption
